newsitem.title: USA: Petrolite to explore business combinations.
newsitem.headline: Petrolite to explore business combinations.

text.p: Petrolite Corp said Friday that due to concerns that its largest shareholder was considering a sale or merger of the company, it plans to explore possible business combinations with third parties.

The company said a special committee formed in June to review its options was concerned that its largest shareholder, Wm. S. Barnickel & Co, would go through with a sale or merger without "regard to whether maximum shareholder value can be realized."

Petrolite said it had rejected two expressions of interest -- one that indicated a value of at least $40 per share, and another that came in at a range of $40 to $44 per share. The company said the two proposals were "clearly inadequate."
Petrolite, a specialty chemical company, said it plans to explore possible business combinations. It has retained Goldman, Sachs & Co as its financial adviser.
